raw_response: DESCRIPTION: This line plot illustrates the loss values over the course of training iterations for five different models. The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration", spans from 0 to 140,000 iterations with tick marks at regular intervals of 20,000. The y-axis, labeled "Loss", ranges from 2.4 to 3.4 and uses a linear scale. The plot contains five distinct lines: a purple line for "Vanilla", a blue line for "StrmLLM (n=64)", an orange line for "SepLLM (n=64)", a green line for "SepLLM (n=64, H)", a red line for "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)", and a dark blue line for "SepLLM (n=128)". All lines start at a high loss value near 3.4 at iteration 0 and exhibit a rapid initial decline, followed by a slower decrease and eventual stabilization around a loss value of approximately 2.5. The "Vanilla" model starts at 3.4 and ends at 2.5. The "StrmLLM (n=64)" model starts at 3.4 and ends at 2.6. The "SepLLM (n=64)" model starts at 3.4 and ends at 2.5. The "SepLLM (n=64, H)" model starts at 3.4 and ends at 2.5. The "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" model starts at 3.4 and ends at 2.5. The "SepLLM (n=128)" model starts at 3.4 and ends at 2.5. All lines show a downward trend, with the "Vanilla" model initially decreasing fastest, followed by the "StrmLLM (n=64)" model, then the "SepLLM" variants. The "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" and "SepLLM (n=128)" models exhibit relatively stable performance after reaching lower loss values.
